mission: Accelerating the development and adoption of non-invasive image-guided focused ultrasound to treat disease.

stages.name: Letter of Intent (LOI)
stages.purpose: First-pass screen for fit. Foundation staff aim to review within two weeks.

criteria.name: Mission Fit
criteria.description: Does the proposed work use non-invasive image-guided focused ultrasound to treat disease? Projects that don't use FUS, use it diagnostically only, or target non-disease applications (e.g. cosmetic) score low.
criteria.scale: 1 (no fit) – 5 (clear, central use of FUS to treat disease)

criteria.name: Strategic Priority Alignment
criteria.description: Does the project target a priority disease (neurodegenerative, priority oncology, veterinary) or a priority mechanism (immunomodulation, neuromodulation, gene therapy, drug delivery, sonodynamic)? Strong fit hits both. Weak fit may use FUS but for an indication outside current priorities.

stages.name: Full Proposal
stages.purpose: Detailed peer review of invited proposals.

criteria.name: Scientific Merit
criteria.description: Is the science novel, hypothesis-driven, and grounded in prior literature? Does it advance the field?

criteria.name: Feasibility
criteria.description: Is the methodology sound and achievable within ~1 year and ~$100k for preclinical awards? Are required resources available?

criteria.name: Team
criteria.description: Does the PI and team have demonstrated expertise in focused ultrasound and the target disease area?

criteria.name: Eligibility
criteria.description: Does the project meet formal requirements (institution type, scope exclusions like large capital purchases or pure equipment development)?

decision_thresholds.FUND: Stage 1 weighted score >= 3.5 AND no individual Stage 1 criterion below 2.
decision_thresholds.DECLINE: Stage 1 weighted score < 3.5 OR any individual Stage 1 criterion below 2.
